_edit: This is the only file to update for a Wednesday. Use plain dates like Wednesday, October 7 · 6:30 PM (Eastern). Leave a string empty to hide it. Do not add a maps or signup URL unless it is a real http(s) link. Prefix unfinished copy with PLACEHOLDER. Set sample to false when this week is real. Chapel = high school, Annex = junior high. Never call Oakland home. Never add student names, contacts, or prayer requests.

gathering.title: Small group connect
gathering.bigIdea: The message is short. Then you connect with your group.
bullets: Hang out from 6:00 to 8:00. Service starts at 6:30. Pickup through 8:15.
Dinner starts at 5. Pizza is a dollar.
Bring a friend if you do not have a group yet.

events.name: Church prayer night
events.summary: Free. The bus leaves Family Church Windermere at 5:45 PM for the prayer night at Lakeside, and you are back around 8:30 PM. Sign up on BAND. Ask a leader for the invite.

events.name: Be Class
events.summary: Membership and baptism next step. Third Sunday of every month. Next one is October 18. Time and room are not posted yet.

events.name: Pumpkin Party
events.summary: Student costume night, in place of regular Wednesday. Church-friendly costumes, or come as you are. Pickup through 8:15.

events.name: 24-hour prayer
events.when: Friday, October 30, noon, through Saturday, October 31, noon
events.summary: One-hour signup blocks. No live band. Stations, softer lighting, and playlists. High school and up only from 10 PM to 6 AM.

events.name: Friendsgiving
events.summary: In place of regular Wednesday. Guests are welcome and do not need to bring food. A side or dessert is welcome if you want to bring one.

events.name: Student Christmas Party
events.summary: Christmas party in place of regular Wednesday. Bring a friend. Pickup through 8:15.

campuses.name: Windermere
campuses.arrival: Wednesday doors are at 6:00. Dinner starts at 5 if you want pizza. A leader will help you find a group.

campuses.name: Oakland
campuses.arrival: A sister campus. Ask a leader where students meet when you visit.

firstTime.intro: First Wednesday, or a parent checking the plan. No account. No check-in. This app does not ask for a student’s name.

blocks.title: A leader will help you find a group
blocks.body: You do not have to figure the building out alone. Wednesday is the best night to get to know people and find a small group.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.body: Pizza starts at 5 and costs a dollar. You can also come at 6:00.

blocks.title: When you arrive
blocks.body: Doors are at 6:00. Hang out until 8:00. Pickup is through 8:15.

blocks.title: Chapel and Annex
blocks.body: High school meets in Chapel. Junior high meets in Annex.
